title: [finding] Seven gates under-match their declared population — led by check:stall-guard-headroom, whose only declared literal is a repo slug that reaches no file at all
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`, as the PM-side split of **#13303**'s confirmed subset. ⛔ **Ungraded and unrouted** — `domain:*`, priority and type are triage's. Filed **unassigned**.

Sibling of the six-gate `packages/spec` export-surface cluster (**#13518**), which is one shape and one repair and is therefore its own card. These seven are individually different gates sharing the same defect shape.

## The seven, confirmed by reading each gate's own header (#13303, on `origin/main@e7191ce7`)

| gate |
|---|
| **`check:stall-guard-headroom`** ⭐ lead — see below |
| `check:skill-docs` |
| `check:service-providers` |
| `check:turbo-task-graph` |
| `check:nul-bytes` |
| `check-comment-mask-corpus` |
| `check:refd-timer-probe` |

## ⭐ Why `check:stall-guard-headroom` should lead

Its **only declared literal is the repo slug `objectstack-ai/objectstack`** — which is not a path and **reaches no tracked file at all**. ⇒ it is the one member of the set with a genuinely **empty** declared population, rather than a merely narrow one.

⚠️ That also makes it the clearest test of whatever repair is chosen: a fix that does not move this gate has not addressed the shape.

## ⛔ Not claimed here

- ⛔ **No remedy prescribed.** #13303's triage note is explicit that a repair pattern is **already proven** and ⛔ **a second one must not be invented**.
- ⛔ Not asserted that all seven want the *same* repair — they share a shape, not necessarily a mechanism. ⭐ Establishing which of the seven the proven pattern actually fits is part of the work, and a measured *"three of these need something else"* is a good outcome, not a failure.
- ⚠️ **These are CONFIRMED, not candidates.** Each was confirmed by reading the gate's own header for what it re-derives and from where — the same reading that **falsified three** of the original card's named "strongest candidates", one of which would have repeated an already-adjudicated mistake (#10542).

## ⚠️ A trap this set inherits, measured in #13303

`artifactOnlySilence` classified this population **mechanically** as 21 artifact-only vs 11 "has a directory literal", while the **header reading** found otherwise — because `collapseHint` does not resolve extensionless module specifiers. ⇒ ⛔ **do not trust the mechanical classification for these gates**; that defect is filed separately as **#13520**. Read the headers.

## Re-check

```
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack
grep -n "objectstack-ai/objectstack" scripts/check-stall-guard-headroom.mjs
```

⚠️ `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` moves several times a day — ⛔ re-derive rather than quoting this card.

## Refs

- **#13303** — the census, with the full 30-source classification, the three falsifications, and the two zeros correctly refused as readings
- **#13518** — the six-gate `packages/spec` cluster, split out as one shape / one repair
- **#13520** — the `artifactOnlySilence` classifier defect this census surfaced
